package.name: scan_l0
package.description: Pure-Python (no ROS) groove sensing run for the VC nano 3D-Z profiler: the 1G core orchestration (teach_1g + compute worker), motion planning with the envelope and the cell world, sensor session, job / calibration / platform config files. The robot platform is the MoveIt adapter in hongik_scan_ros. Uses scan_core and vc3dz_driver.
